attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Client-side JS drag/drop logic is significantly restructured with new global variables and dataset-driven type checks, and if a widget/content-type container lacks the new data-content-type attribute (e.g. custom shape overrides in downstream themes/modules), the dataset.contentTypes.split call will throw a JS error breaking Bag/Flow part editors."}

reason: Client-side JS drag/drop logic is significantly restructured with new global variables and dataset-driven type checks, and if a widget/content-type container lacks the new data-content-type attribute (e.g. custom shape overrides in downstream themes/modules), the dataset.contentTypes.split call will throw a JS error breaking Bag/Flow part editors.
